notes.title: Update notes for 7 July
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

I’ve just released a fresh new update, including some long-awaited improvements and fixes:


[list]
[*]
Game engine upgraded to Unity 6 – This took a bit longer than expected and involved quite a bit of extra behind-the-scenes work, but it unlocks new possibilities for performance and future content.
[*]Top Pilots Leaderboard (Steam) – Now showing scores from players worldwide!
[*]Leaderboard now accessible in the Main Menu
[*]Hard difficulty now earns DOUBLE credits
[*]UI improvements and better usability
[*]Bug fix: You can now complete Level 7 (Metropolitan) as intended!
[*]Several other bugs squashed
[/list]

Thanks for participating in Early Access!
TK
Developer of Gravity Cab

notes.title: Gravity Cab Early Access on Steam on 31 January 2025
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44670325/0f84c68596bb127139adc9816c4ab35b70cc79f8.png[/img]


[h1]Gravity Cab Early Access on Steam on 31 January 2025! 🎉[/h1]


Dear Gravity Cab Fans,


First and foremost, thank you for your incredible patience, support, and enthusiasm as I’ve been working to bring [b]Gravity Cab[/b] to life. As a solo indie developer with no external funding, this game has been a true labour of love, created during every spare moment I could find outside my full-time job (and, yes, even my second job). It has been a challenging journey, but your encouragement and interest have kept me going every step of the way.


After careful consideration, I’m excited to announce that Gravity Cab will launch in [b]Early Access on Steam on 31 January 2025![/b] 🎉
 

I was originally set out to release the game earlier this year, but, as some of you know, I had to adjust the timeline several times to ensure the game reaches the quality you all deserve. Each delay has allowed me to refine the experience, add more exciting content, and polish the mechanics to bring you a game I’m truly proud of. Now, with just a few final bug fixes and a marketing push ahead, I’m confident that Gravity Cab will be ready to make its debut at the end of January.

 

[h2]Why Early Access?[/h2]

Launching in Early Access is a decision I’ve made not just to bring you the game sooner, but also to include YOU in the process. Early Access will allow me to gather your valuable feedback as you explore the game, refine the experience further, and build the remaining content together with the community. Plus, buying the game in Early Access means you’ll get it at a lower price, with free updates as I add new levels and features leading up to the full release.

 

[h2]What’s Next?[/h2]

The full release of Gravity Cab will come [b]sometime in 2025[/b], and its timeline will largely depend on the success of Early Access. Every purchase, review, and feedback will bring me closer achieving the goal to focus fully on game development. Rest assured, I’m committed to deliver a game experience that you will enjoy for years to come.

So, mark your calendar for [b]31 January 2025[/b] and prepare to defy gravity! 🚀

Thank you for your ongoing support and interest in Gravity Cab! If you haven’t already, please consider adding the game to your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2577010/Gravity_Cab/]wishlist[/url]. Wishlisting helps tremendously by boosting the game’s visibility and keeping you updated on all future announcements and updates. Every wishlist counts and means the world to a solo developer like me.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2577010/Gravity_Cab/]Add to Wishlist Here[/url]


Cheers,
Tamas
Creator of Gravity Cab

notes.title: Update Available for Gravity Cab Demo (v1.04)
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

I'm excited to share that a new update for Gravity Cab Demo is now live on Steam! This update brings a couple of exciting changes to enhance your gaming experience:

[list]
[*]
[b]New Difficulty Levels:[/b] Introducing two new difficulty levels, Easy and Hard. With Easy mode, vehicle controls are more responsive and forgiving, making it a blast to navigate through the challenging environments. Hard mode offers a more authentic experience, similar to the classic Space Taxi game.
[*]
[b]Improved Damage System:[/b] The damage system has been refined to be less punitive, making gameplay more enjoyable overall. Now you can focus on the thrill of flying without worrying too much about minor mishaps.
[*]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b] This update also includes various bug fixes to improve overall stability and performance.
[/list]

I hope you enjoy the new features and improvements! Don't forget to share your feedback on the changes.

Thank you for your support!

notes.title: Controlling your Gravity Cab is more fun with this update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44670325/f5e08dc6d220f9803b9e301504580739a2b6123d.png[/img]

Hey Gravity Cab Pilot,

I just wanted to let you know that I've listened to your feedback and I'm working hard to fix all the issues and make changes according to your requests.

With this [b]UPDATE[/b] you can fly the taxi with open doors at low speeds, so [b]landing on a pad and pick-up passengers got easier than ever[/b]. No frustration any more when you are on the spot, and the door was closed when you accidentally pressed left or right.

Please give it another go and let me know that what do you think about these changes.

See you out there,
Tamas

notes.title: Hey Everyone, Thanks for Visiting the Community Hub!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44670325/a99292cdfb8e395e78b96a8f2fae800246eec985.png[/img]

Hey Everyone,

Thanks for visiting the Community Hub! I've got some thrilling news to share with you all. My upcoming indie game, Gravity Cab, is set to make its debut on the Steam Store, and I can't wait to take you on this exciting adventure.

Gravity Cab takes you on a journey to the depths of a distant planet, where you step into the shoes of a fearless taxi driver navigating through intricate underground caverns. With realistic physics, including momentum and gravity, every twist and turn promises a heart-pounding challenge. You'll master the controls, solve puzzles, and ensure safe passenger transfers while collecting rewards for your skill and speed.

[h2][b]What You Can Expect of Gravity Cab:[/b][/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Unique Gameplay:[/b] Experience a fresh take on classic gameplay with modern twists.
[*] [b]Intriguing Story:[/b] Unfold a captivating narrative as you progress through the game.
[*] [b]Challenging Levels:[/b] Start with the basics and evolve into a master taxi driver.
[*] [b]Physics at Play:[/b] Realistic physics add depth to every moment of gameplay.
[*] [b]Stunning Visuals:[/b] Immerse yourself in a world brought to life with vibrant graphics.
[/list]

I'm eager to share this gaming experience with you, and I'm working tirelessly to bring you the best possible game. To add to the excitement, I'll be sharing a free DEMO with the Steam community when it's ready and letting you to be the first to experience the game.

But that's not all. I invite you to add Gravity Cab to your Steam Wishlist and click to follow the game too. By following, you'll receive notifications about updates, ensuring you don't miss a thing as I progress towards launch.

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm. I can't wait to embark on this exciting gaming adventure with all of you. Stay tuned for more updates, and I'll see you in the game soon!

[i]-- Tamas from Gravity Cab HQ[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44670325/a4788829fcc7b8b466485b92b743319094211c66.png[/img]
